answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can submit work, then slash that stake when independent audits prove fraud or duplicate identities coordinated to claim the same reward. A sybil operator must lock real capital for each persona, so multiplying accounts multiplies the amount at risk; cheap email addresses no longer create cheap influence. The falcon may spot a gale of new accounts at dawn, but only verified evidence triggers slashing, limiting false accusations.
